transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?
Any time I’m near where there might be snakes, I feel an immediate rush of fear that I can’t shake. It's become really overwhelming, so I decided it was finally time to talk to someone about it.

Can you tell me if this fear of snakes is causing you to avoid certain places or activities that you would otherwise enjoy, or is it more of a general anxiety that you experience in various situations?

It’s definitely not a general anxiety; it’s very specific to snakes and places where they might be. It has forced me to avoid things I love, like skipping hikes with my trail club, and I even have to delegate school field trips and nature walks to other staff. It really makes me feel like I’m not fully doing my job or living the active life I used to enjoy.
Can you describe how you feel when you see a picture of a snake or think about snakes when you're not in a situation where you might actually encounter one?

Even just looking at a photo of a snake or thinking about them triggers an immediate wave of panic. My chest tightens, my heart starts pounding, and I get this intense, out-of-control fear that feels way bigger than any actual threat in that moment.
When you experience this intense fear or panic in response to snakes or thoughts of snakes, do you ever have any thoughts of losing control or going crazy?
No, I wouldn't say I have thoughts of going crazy or losing my mind. It's more that the fear itself feels completely overwhelming and totally out of my control in that moment.
Have you noticed any significant distress or impairment in your daily life, social relationships, or work performance specifically due to your fear of snakes?

Yes, it has caused a lot of issues at work and in my personal life. I've had to delegate key outdoor lessons and field trips to other staff, and I've missed out on hiking with my social club. It really makes me feel like I'm not fully doing my job or living the active life I used to enjoy.
Can you tell me if your fear of snakes has been present for as long as you can remember, or if there was a specific event or time when this fear started?

I had a vague dislike of them as a kid, but this severe fear really started about two and a half years ago. During a work planning visit to a reptile exhibit, a staff member tried to hand me a small snake, which completely terrified me. Since that day, the fear has just stuck with me and gotten more entrenched.
Can you think of any situation where you've been exposed to a snake, either in person or through a picture, and you didn't experience this intense fear response?

No, there are absolutely no exceptions. Even just seeing a simple photo of a snake in a school curriculum brochure immediately triggers that same intense panic, chest tightening, and pounding heart. Whether it's in person or just an image, the fear response is always immediate and completely overwhelming.
